# Blanc. Events

> Event production studio and equipment hire company based in Manchester, UK. We offer lighting design, full event production, and dry hire of lighting and DJ equipment for nightclubs, corporate events, private parties, and live productions across the North West.

## About

Blanc. Events is a Manchester-based event production company and specialist hire operation serving the North West's most ambitious venues, agencies, and event planners. We invest in industry-leading equipment from Astera, Pioneer DJ, MA Lighting, and L-Acoustics.

Contact: hello@blanc-events.co.uk | 07584192578
Address: 19 Cheetham Hill Road, Manchester, M4 4FY

## Services

- Lighting Design & Production — DMX-controlled environments, custom-plotted and operated
- Astera Wireless Fixture Hire — Astera Titan Tubes, AX1 Tubes, and Helios fixtures
- DJ Equipment Hire — Pioneer CDJ-3000, DJM-A9, XDJ-AZ, Technics turntables, mixers
- Sound & PA Hire — Professional PA systems and backline for events of all sizes
- Dry Hire — Professional AV, lighting, and DJ equipment hire with delivery across Manchester
- Full Event Production — Complete technical delivery for corporate, nightlife, and private events
- On-site Production Management — Dedicated lead technician for the duration of your event

## Equipment Inventory

### Lighting
- Astera Titan Tubes (wireless DMX, battery-powered)
- Astera AX1 Tubes
- Moving heads and wash fixtures
- Uplighting and architectural lighting

### DJ & Audio
- Pioneer CDJ-3000 media players
- Pioneer DJM-A9 mixer
- AlphaTheta XDJ-AZ all-in-one
- Professional PA and sound systems
